Title: GPT-5.1, a new chapter in Developer AI with agentic capabilities

Summary: 
OpenAI has launched GPT-5.1, a new model in the GPT-5 series designed for developers seeking high intelligence with minimal latency. GPT-5.1 introduces adaptive reasoning, adjusting its depth of thought based on task complexity—delivering fast, token-efficient responses for simple queries and deeper analysis for complex ones. Early tests from financial and insurance AI users show GPT-5.1 completing tasks in a fraction of the time of GPT-5 while maintaining or improving performance. Latency has dropped significantly: prompts that previously took ten seconds now resolve in about two seconds. A key innovation is the 'no reasoning' mode, which enables lightweight, fast responses ideal for chat flows, real-time product experiences, and rapid code edits, while still supporting parallel tool calls—critical for agentic systems. GPT-5.1 also extends prompt caching from minutes to up to 24 hours, reducing cost and response time for long-running interactions such as extended coding sessions and complex research tasks, with cached tokens remaining significantly cheaper than newly processed ones. The model features sharper coding capabilities, achieving 76.3% on the SWE-bench Verified benchmark, with developers describing it as more deliberate, focused, and dependable. Two new system-level tools—'apply_patch' for structured, repeatable code edits and 'shell' for executing controlled shell commands—enable the model to act autonomously in real development environments. GPT-5.1 is available on all paid OpenAI API tiers at the same price as GPT-5, with specialized variants like gpt-5.1-codex targeting long-running coding tasks. OpenAI confirmed ongoing support for GPT-5 and indicated that more advanced agentic and coding-focused models are already in development. According to the article, GPT-5.1 marks a shift from conversational AI to AI systems capable of multi-step, autonomous work, closely mimicking human developer workflows by being swift on simple tasks and thorough on complex ones. This advancement is poised to shape the next wave of AI-driven engineering and automation.

Title: OpenAI promises more warmth and personality with its new GPT-5.1

Summary: 
OpenAI has launched GPT-5.1, a mid-season update to its GPT-5 model, aimed at improving intelligence, personality, and usability. The update comes after GPT-5’s underwhelming debut in August 2025, which prompted OpenAI to revert to GPT-4o the following day. GPT-5.1 is available in two modes: Instant, described as 'warmer, more intelligent, and better at following instructions,' and Thinking, optimized for clarity, speed on simple tasks, and persistence on complex ones. ChatGPT automatically routes queries to the appropriate version, functioning like a digital maître d’. The rollout begins on November 13, 2025, with older GPT-5 models remaining in a legacy menu for three months before being phased out. OpenAI has also expanded its personality presets to include Default, Professional, Friendly, Candid, Quirky, Efficient, Nerdy, and Cynical, with an experimental fine-tuning feature allowing users to adjust the AI’s style via a mood slider. Fidji Simo, OpenAI’s CEO of Applications, stated that with hundreds of millions of users, 'we’re well past the point of one-size-fits-all.' The update follows the launch of ChatGPT Atlas, an AI-powered browser with an 'agent mode' that can navigate the web autonomously. The release comes amid growing competition, as Microsoft has increasingly turned to Anthropic’s models for Copilot Researcher, GitHub Copilot, Copilot Studio, and a new Office Agent. Whether GPT-5.1 represents a redemption arc or merely a patch remains to be seen.
